page.heading: Account settings
page.subtitle: Your details, sign-in, app appearance and data management.
page.demoNotice: You are using a shared demo account, so changing sign-in details, clearing all data and deleting the account are turned off here. Create your own account to try them.

profile.title: Profile and sign-in
profile.subtitle: Account details. Changing the login, e-mail address or password requires your password.
profile.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, one digit and one capital letter.

credentials.saveError: Couldn't save the changes. Check the details and try again.

password.title: Change password
password.hint: At least 8 characters, one digit and one capital letter.

validation.loginMin: Login must be at least 3 characters

limits.title: Budget limits
limits.description: Each category has a weekly, monthly and yearly limit. Changes apply from the current periods; the amount of a single period is changed in Budgets.

data.title: Your data
data.subtitle: Clear expenses and budget history. Categories and their limits stay.

resetCategories.title: Clear selected categories
resetCategories.description: Deletes the expenses and budget history of the selected categories.
resetCategories.dialogText: The expenses and budget history of the selected categories will be deleted. The categories and their limits stay.
resetCategories.done: Data of the selected categories cleared

resetData.title: Clear all data
resetData.description: Deletes all expenses and budget history so you can start over.
resetData.dialogText: All expenses and budget history will be deleted. Categories and their limits stay.

deleteAccount.title: Danger zone
deleteAccount.subtitle: Delete the account permanently
deleteAccount.description: The account will be deleted permanently and you will not be able to sign in to it.
deleteAccount.dialogText: The account will be deleted permanently and you will be signed out.

confirm.hint: This cannot be undone. Confirm it with the account's e-mail address and password.

demoAccountBlocked: This is a demo account - this action is not available. Create your own account to try it.
